sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Aseptic Blow-Fill-Seal Formulation of Preservative-Free Lubricants

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Double Taxation Agreement (1984, as amended 2013)
France–Hong Kong SAR Double Taxation Agreement (2010)
EU–Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA, provisionally applied)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier) Articles L.561-1 et seq.; Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.561-45 et seq. concerning the register of beneficial owners, as amended by Ordonnance n° 2020-115; Décret n° 2020-118; Directive (EU) 2015/849 (4AMLD) and Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5AMLD), as transposed into French law; TRACFIN obligations under Article L.561-23 et seq.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity document for every shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or issuing authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney granted to the French incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin or French notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized beneficial owner declaration (RBE/UBO form) signed by all shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin or French notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors and ultimate beneficial owners against EU sanctions lists, UN Security Council consolidated lists, OFAC SDN lists, TRACFIN suspected financial crime files, INTERPOL, and official French PEP registries; enhanced due diligence and source-of-wealth verification required for any politically exposed person; negative media and adverse news screening as part of risk-based AML/CFT compliance under Article L.561-4-1 C. mon. fin.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet des formalités des entreprises — formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (INPI); company data via Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), accessible through Infogreffe — infogreffe.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in the French language or transliterated into Latin script for inclusion in French corporate records; the name must not be misleading, contrary to public order, or contrary to good morals; the legal form suffix 'SARL' must appear in all official documents and the company name must be unique within the relevant business scope and not infringe prior registered trademarks or existing company names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected by INPI or by the Greffe du tribunal de commerce, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Director General of INPI within two months of notification; a further judicial appeal can be brought before the Paris Court of Appeal. Where the rejection originates from the RCS registration clerk, an expedited summary application may be lodged before the President of the Tribunal Judiciaire for a ruling on the lawfulness of the refusal, and the application solicitor may resubmit a corrected name through the Guichet unique.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A domiciliation service or virtual office is acceptable for administrative functions in a French SARL, subject to the rules of Code de commerce Article L.123-11-1 (maximum duration for domiciliation without a fixed point of contact). However, for a licensed manufacturer of sterile ophthalmic eye drops, a physical operating facility compliant with European GMP and ANSM licensing requirements is indispensable; the virtual office cannot satisfy the commercial substance mandate for pharmaceutical manufacturing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 75% for registered pharmaceutical manufacturing premises due to ANSM GMP inspections, Ministry of Health surveillance, and anti-fraud controls; approximately 10% for purely administrative registered offices in low-risk sectors.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search, pre-clearance and corporate name due diligence (INPI + Infogreffe + trademark screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory INSEE/INPI fee schedule and prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company formation filing with Greffe du Tribunal de commerce and issuance of Extrait Kbis
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of greffiers (tarif des greffiers)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal announcement in a French journal d'annonces légales (JAL)
Apostille, notarization and consular legalization of foreign corporate documents and UBO bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary / apostille office in jurisdiction of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff plus official apostille fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French articles of association (statuts SARL), shareholders' resolutions and UBO declaration
Registered office domiciliation service — first year

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. (SARL incorporation and RCS registration); Civil Code Articles 1832-1844-17 (general company law); Code monétaire et financier for capital escrow; Public Health Code Articles L.5124-1 et seq. for pharmaceutical establishment licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS), administered by the Greffe du tribunal de commerce; filings are submitted through the INPI Guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Demande d'immatriculation au registre du commerce et des sociétés, supported by the signed articles of association, capital deposit attestation, legal publication notice, declaration of conformity, and manager declarations of eligibility; transmitted electronically to the Commercial Court Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL under Article L.223-2. If capital is fixed, cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% at subscription, with the balance payable within five years. The full cash capital must be deposited into a blocked escrow account with a bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until the RCS registration certificate (extrait K-bis) is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a duly convened shareholders' meeting of the SARL, the following resolutions were adopted unanimously: 1. RESOLVED, that the shares of the company are subscribed in full by the initial shareholders and that cash contributions shall be deposited into the escrow account opened with [Bank/Notary] to remain blocked until registration; 2. RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at [address], within the territorial jurisdiction of the Commercial Court of [city], and the legal representation attached thereto is approved; 3. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Manager (Gérant) for an indefinite term, with all powers necessary to complete incorporation, open bank accounts, sign filings, and lawfully represent the company before third parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the SARL articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial shareholders and appointed legal advisor; in France private deed is sufficient unless notarization is required for real property contribution or special legal perfection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare draft French-language statutes containing corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose including aseptic formulation of sterile ophthalmic eye drops, duration, share capital and contributions, management clauses, and decision-making rules. All initial members must sign each page of the statutes (acte sous seing privé) or a notarial deed where applicable. The manager must be designated in a separate act or within the statutes.
required_dossiers: Projet de statuts (draft articles)
Identity documents and proof of address of all initial members
Contribution statement and valuation report for any contributions in kind
Consent of the proposed manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or a third party identifies a statutory omission, execute a corrective deed (acte rectificatif/annexe) approved unanimously by the members and resubmit. If notarization is required and absent due to property contribution, re-execute the deed before a notaire and attach it to the filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked capital deposit account and issuance of the capital deposit attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations holding the 'compte bloqué' for the company in formation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company en formation. Each subscribing member must transfer or deposit their cash contribution before signature of the definitive statutes or before filing. Obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds provided by the depositary stating that the full cash capital is unavailable and will be released only upon RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Draft or executed articles of association
Identity documents of the manager and members
Bank transfer or deposit evidence for subscribed cash capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the attestation contains identity or amount mismatches, ask the depositary to issue a corrected certificate. If the bank refuses the account, substitute another French credit institution or notary and execute a revised deposit certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the mandatory incorporation notice in a legal announcement gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the prefecture of the court's territorial jurisdiction where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Place an avis de constitution in a legally authorized gazette stating the company form (SARL), corporate name, registered office, corporate object, amount of share capital, manager identity, and the Commercial Court where the company will be regartized. Obtain from the gazette an extrait de publication or attestation de parution, which is required for the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Text of the avis de constitution
Articles of association or project of statutes for verification by the gazette
Capital attestation if required by the gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette publication does not exactly comply with legal content requirements, publish a corrective version and obtain a new attestation. If publication occurs after the filing, withdraw the filing and resubmit once the correct publication is available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the incorporation application through the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique, which transmits the file to the Greffe du tribunal de commerce for RCS registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, select 'création d'entreprise', form SARL. Complete the formalité d'immatriculation, upload the signed articles, capital deposit attestation, publication proof, declaration of manager eligibility, identity documents, and pay the official filing fee. Verify the data before submission; the system generates a receipt of deposit and sends the file to the Commercial Court Registry.
required_dossiers: Acte constitutif / statuts signés
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Justification de publication dans un journal d'annonces légales
Déclaration sur l'honneur de non-condamnation des dirigeants
Identité et justificatifs des dirigeants et associés
Pouvoir signé si le dépôt est effectué par mandataire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues an observation or query, the company receives a notification via the Guichet unique. Submit corrected documents online within 15 calendar days. If the filing is rejected, remedy the stated irregularities and resubmit a complete application; rights of priority are preserved where the original filing was within legal time limits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and issuance of the K-bis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After positive examination, the Greffe registers the SARL in the RCS, allocates the SIREN/RCS number and SIRET establishment number, and issues the extrait K-bis. The company acquires legal personality on the date of registration. The notice is published in the BODACC.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgement of the formalité d'immatriculation accepted
Proof of payment of registration taxes and fees
K-bis extract request if document is needed separately
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis contains inaccurate data, file a rectification request with the Greffe under Article R.123-91 of the French Commercial Code. If the registry refuses registration or correction, apply by petition to the President of the Commercial Court or initiate summary proceedings before the competent court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, social, and statutory administrative activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DGFiP (Service des impôts des entreprises), URSSAF, and INSEE via the data transmitted by the Guichet unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After K-bis issuance, verify that the company is assigned: SIREN/SIRET, code NAF/APE 2120? properly recorded for pharmaceutical formulation; VAT intracommunautary number (numéro TVA intracommunautaire) once registered for VAT; EORI if importing raw materials; and employer account with URSSAF for payroll and occupational rate classification. The manager must open the company's operational bank account and activate the social declaration obligations.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Registered office address proof
Manager's identification and effect of appointment
Estimate of first payroll and activity start date
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT or EORI numbers are not issued automatically, apply directly to the local SIE for VAT registration and to the French Customs for EORI. If the social rate is incorrectly classified, file a request for adjustment with URSSAF and provide the corriger activity classification certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé), Direction de l'Inspection, in coordination with DREAL for classified installations and the labor inspectorate for occupational health.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'ouverture d'établissement pharmaceutique (Articles L.5124-1 and L.5124-3 of the French Public Health Code) and EU Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification for sterile ophthalmic eye drops; a separate manufacturing authorization/MIA for medicinal product batches is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL), Ministry of Ecological Transition; water discharges coordinated with the local water authority (agence de l'eau).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE (Installations classées pour la protection de l'environnement) classification: 'Enregistrement' for standard pharmaceutical formulation facilities; 'Autorisation' requiring a full EIA Report where hazardous substance quantities and process risks exceed legal thresholds; otherwise DREAL performs a case-by-case screening and may issue an exempt notice.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the French Environment Code and ICPE ministerial orders: wastewater pH between 5.5 and 8.5, total suspended solids ≤30 mg/L, COD ≤125 mg/L, BOD5 ≤40 mg/L, and no active pharmaceutical ingredient discharge without treatment; volatile organic compound emissions must meet Directive 2010/75/EU and the applicable BREF; pharmaceutical waste, including contaminated packaging and rejected batches, must be tracked through authorized waste treatment channels with bordereau de suivi.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and prevention clearance must be obtained from the departmental fire service (SDIS) and the local planning authority; structural load inspection is required for cleanrooms, autoclaves, water purification systems, and heavy technical equipment, typically attested by a bureau de contrôle; workplace clearance requires CARSAT registration, a risk assessment document (DUERP), occupational health approval, and compliance with accessibility and emergency exit requirements for sterile manufacturing areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities must register for VAT (TVA) if conducting taxable activities in France or exceeding turnover thresholds. Submit application via impots.gouv.fr or through a French tax representative, including company details, activity description, and supporting documents. Obtain SIREN/SIRET number and VAT identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Entity-level taxation applies under French corporate tax regime. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD Directive.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing for B2B transactions via API to tax authorities (since 2024), digital stamping of invoices, and fiscal clearance through PEP platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the EU upon proof of export. Offshore services zero-rated if performed outside France for non-EU clients with no French establishment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Proof of Inward Remittance or Payment Receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims subject to penalties up to 80% of the VAT amount claimed, interest charges, and potential criminal prosecution. Retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT with surcharges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France); external financial relations and exchange-control oversight delegated to the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; banking supervision by the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully liberalised current-account and capital-account convertibility regime under the Code monétaire et financier and EU Treaty free movement of capital. Profit remittance is unrestricted for EU/EEA investors; distributions to non-EU shareholders are subject to domestic withholding tax (generally 25-30%, reduced or exempt under applicable double-tax treaties) after approval of the annual financial statements. No special foreign-investment approval is required for share capital injections, although extra-EU inbound direct investments may trigger a post-closing prior declaration to DG Trésor under the foreign-investment screening regime. Dividend and interest repatriation is legally unimpeded once bank KYC, tax-residence evidence and treaty-relief forms are in place.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory currency surrender or mandatory conversion applies in France: export proceeds may be freely retained and recycled in EUR or foreign currency. However, all cross-border transfers involving non-EU counterparties must be executed through an authorised intermediary credit institution and declared for monetary and balance-of-payments statistical purposes to Banque de France when the transaction threshold applies. Export documentation (commercial invoice, bill of lading, customs export declaration via DELTA G) must be archived to evidence the underlying trade flow, particularly for ex-works EU sales of sterile ophthalmic pharmaceuticals.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance LC Facility

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (LCL for domestic operations)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for operational subsidiaries. ACPR-licensed or EEA-passported electronic money institutions/fintechs (e.g., Qonto, Shine, Treezor) can open operational sub-accounts quickly and provide payment cards and SEPA rails, but they cannot host capital escrow or statutory share-capital deposits, lack full trade-finance/LC issuance capability, and are generally unsuitable for large SWIFT/LC flows. Legal constraint: such providers are not credit institutions and cannot perform documentary-credit functions; some French Tier-1 banks reject beneficiary relationships with unlicensed crypto/EMI structures, so a dedicated commercial bank account remains mandatory for escrow and treasury.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French Tier-1 banks impose a mandatory physical KYC interview with the gérant (general manager), directors and all 25%-plus beneficial owners; remote opening is not generally available for a French SARL holding an ANSM pharmaceutical licence. Videoconference onboarding is accepted only under exceptional ACPR guidance with strong eIDAS identity verification, but most institutions require an in-person interview at the branch/head office and a French registered office verification. The gérant acting as legal representative must appear physically with original Kbis extract, passport, proof of address, Articles of Association, and the RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) extract; corporate foreign shareholders must provide a certified good-standing certificate from the home registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharmaceutical manufacturing licence and GMP validity doubts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ANSM manufacturing authorisation, GMP certificate issued under EU Directive 2017/1572, ISO 15378 certification for primary packaging of ophthalmic products, and the most recent inspection report with corrective-action records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity or non-EU parent resident outside EEA
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RBE registration confirmation, French Articles of Association with chain-of-custody shareholding table, apostilled corporate registry extracts of each intermediate holding, completed AML declaration of structure plus a detailed group organogramme.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU source funds for capital injection and shareholder loan
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Post-incorporation capital-increase attorneys' certificate, notarised shareholder contribution deed, bank reference letter from the instructing foreign bank, source-of-wealth statement backed by parent company audited financial statements, and signed MT103 wire instruction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions / PEP / adverse-media hits on foreign directors or parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Third-party independent screening reports, official sanctions-list checks in G7/EU/OFAC formats, comprehensive explanation letter with evidence of lawful activity, professional references, and a dedicated negative-media monitoring review prepared by an external compliance consultant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-finance flows inconsistent with LS Pharma business profile (eye-drop B2B medical device/pharma exports)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Framework supply contracts with hospitals/intermediate distributors, pro-forma invoices aligned to ISIC 2100 classification, excipient and active-principle purchase orders, batch-release certificates, import-export commodity code (CN 3004 90 00) and customs DELTA/D declarations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all inbound capital via a single European correspondent banking corridor: foreign parent remits in EUR through SWIFT MT103 to the SARL's capital escrow account, referencing the purpose category for balance-of-payments statistics (Direct Investment - Capital). Where the source jurisdiction mandates purpose codes, adopt ISO 20022 pain.001 for SEPA-side and MT103 field 50K/72 for non-SEPA wires, embedding settlement narrative referring to the capital contribution deed. Post-receipt, deliver to the bank the signed contribution deed, amended Kbis, RBE update, notary/attorney certificate, and the Banque de France reporting declaration, then transfer released funds to the operational account under dual-authorisation treasury control. For extra-EU funds subject to the French foreign-investment screening regime, file the prior/post-facto DG Trésor declaration and retain the receipt before downstream procurement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for supplier wires for raw-material excipients, HDPE/LDPE dropper materials and labels; use commercial documentary DCs via SWIFT MT700 for high-value aseptic packaging and API procurement from third countries, with a sight or 60-day after-sight tenor; settle in EUR via TARGET2 real-time gross settlement or, for intra-EEA low-value flows, SEPA instant via EBA CLEARING. All outbound transactions require dual approval, ISO 20022 pain.001 instructions, the underlying pro-forma/commercial invoice, and, where applicable, the customs export declaration; letter-of-credit reimbursement is advised through the same relationship bank to avoid KYC fragmentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla over-the-counter FX forwards contracted with ACPR- or EEA-licensed credit institutions for EUR/USD, EUR/CNY and EUR/INR exposures
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) through a French authorised bank for restricted-currency settlement where onshore convertibility rules require a settlement reference
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) for term-structuring of shareholder loans and trade receivables
Plain-vanilla currency options and zero-cost collars to cap procurement cost while preserving upside
Exchange-traded FX futures and options cleared via an EU regulated market or multilateral trading facility

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approved annual accounts (balance sheet, income statement, notes) deposited at the Commercial and Companies Registry (RCS), with any confidential non-publication election
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval of accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; registry filing within 1 month thereafter (max 7 months after year-end) per Code de commerce arts. L232-21, L232-23
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court order under penalty (astreinte) can force filing; manager's fine up to EUR 1,500; risk of deregistration if filings omitted for three consecutive periods

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale) - form 2065-SD with 2050-series supporting schedules and IS equalization payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques) - fiscal domicile office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year company: second business day after 1 May plus 15 days for electronic filing; non-calendar year: within 3 months of closing plus 15 days (CGI art. 223-1)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty 10% of taxable base, raised to 40% if unfiled within 30 days of formal notice (80% for concealed activity); monthly late-payment interest of 0.2%; prosecution for criminal tax evasion possible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting (AGO) approving the accounts, appropriating profit and ratifying manager decisions (minutes entered in the decision register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SARL internal corporate records (no filing to a registry absent capital or articles changes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end; extension obtainable only by court order at the manager's request (Code de commerce art. L232-21)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Manager's fine up to EUR 9,000 for failure to submit accounts to associates; shareholder may petition the court to appoint an agent to convene the meeting

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner register (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) update following any change in direct or indirect ownership (no annual re-filing if data unchanged)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS - Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership or of filed data (Code monétaire et financier arts. L561-46, R561-57); annual internal review recommended ahead of the AGO
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 for individuals and EUR 37,500 for legal entities, plus up to 6 months' imprisonment; separate fine for blocking inspection duties

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS) for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022; large taxpayers remain subject to the 3.3% social surcharge on IS where annual IS liability exceeds EUR 763,000, and to the 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable income for eligible SMEs with turnover below EUR 10 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (art. 219-I-b CGI); Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of qualifying sterile and ophthalmic R&D expenses up to EUR 100 million and 5% above that threshold; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% of eligible prototype and clinical trial costs capped at EUR 400,000; Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI) status granting 100% IS exemption in the first profitable year and 50% in the second year for R&D-intensive SMEs during the 2023-2025 window; regional tax incentives under art. 44 sexies CGI for qualifying investments in assisted areas, subject to State aid approval.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited forward (no statutory year cap), but annual offset is capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; optional carryback of losses up to 3 years with a claim cap of EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065 (Cerfa no. 15946) together with the full tax package annexes 2058-A through 2059-G (liasse fiscale); mandatory electronic filing through the EFI portal at impots.gouv.fr; EDI-TDFC protocol for consolidated groups and business uploads.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months of the fiscal year end; for fiscal years ending 31 December the deadline is extended to the first business day after 30 April (in practice 3 May); for off-calendar year ends the return is due no later than the last day of the third month following the fiscal year close.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SARL corporate identity, SIREN/SIRET number, registered office, fiscal year opening and closing dates, and the identity of the legal representative; also confirms the applicable reduced IS rate threshold for SMEs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The French-resident SARL must be designated as the taxpayer; non-resident shareholders have no direct filing right or obligation; the return must include the annex listing non-resident beneficiaries and, where applicable, the managers' fees paid abroad subject to withholding tax under art. 182 A CGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable result computed from statutory net profit with add-backs of non-deductible expenses, depreciation recapture rules, and the integration of foreign exchange and transfer pricing adjustments; carryforward losses are offset here under the annual cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Royalties or service recharge payments to non-resident group companies must be supported by prior transfer pricing documentation and, for cross-border flows falling below EUR 50,000 of related-party turnover, the simplified annex; otherwise the administration may recharacterize the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 230 / impôt sur les sociétés dû
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of final IS due: 15% on the first EUR 42,500 and 25% on the balance for SMEs; cancellation of CIR and CII tax credits; any advance payments made quarterly are deducted, and the remaining balance is paid with the filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders claiming treaty benefits on dividends out of retained earnings must attach proof of effective beneficiary status; the IS field itself is payable by the French entity, not by the foreign parent; early withholding or quarterly payment obligations remain unaffected.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge when no prior demand is issued, 40% after formal notice, and 80% in cases of deliberately false or incomplete filings (art. 1728 CGI); unpaid tax also incurs monthly interest at 0.20% (2.4% annual, art. 1727 CGI), a 5% late payment penalty where payment is not received by the due date, and automatic loss of certain tax credit offsets until the default is regularized.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly IS instalment declarations (acomptes d'IS) processed exclusively by electronic telepayment in the professional accounts area at impots.gouv.fr; no paper form; instalment vouchers correspond to slip series 1327AC-1/4 through 1327AC-4/4.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Instalments due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December of the relevant fiscal year (for calendar-year taxpayers; off-calendar years use the 15th day of the 4th, 7th, 10th, and 13th months, or the 20th day where the administration has granted a dispensation); final settlement is paid at the same time as the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Each instalment equals 25% of the estimated annual IS; taxpayers collect the amounts payable as a percentage of the tax base estimated at the beginning of the year and may reduce instalments if the final IS proves lower.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Funds must be wired in EUR from the French-domiciled SARL treasury to the DGFiP central account; invoicing or payment routing from a non-resident parent or affiliate is not permitted and will be treated as a deficiency subject to recovery.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Missed instalments attract a 5% penalty on the amount not paid plus the monthly 0.20% late interest (art. 1731 and 1727 CGI); the administration issues an automatic collection notice and the taxpayer loses any right to reduce future instalments without prior approval.
